nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: The style guide is measured from the merchant’s own descriptions by src/brand/voice-extract.ts. Paste the values from output/style-guide.json here.

nodes.name: Build fact ledger
nodes.notes: Every sayable fact, with its source path. Nothing downstream may exceed this list.

nodes.name: Anthropic Messages API
nodes.notes: Credential: HTTP Header Auth with name "x-api-key". No temperature / top_p / top_k — removed on claude-opus-5, sending one is a 400.

nodes.name: Validate hard rules
nodes.notes: The gate: banned words, certification claims, SEO lengths, second person, and fact traceability.

nodes.name: Human review gate
nodes.notes: Nothing reaches the store without a person. The workflow pauses here and resumes on the webhook a reviewer calls after reading the copy.

nodes.name: Shopify productUpdate

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "mutation productUpdate($input: ProductInput!) { productUpdate(input: $input) { product { id } userErrors { field message } } }", variables: { input: { id: $json.shopifyProductId, descriptionHtml: $json.copy.bodyHtml, seo: { title: $json.copy.metaTitle, description: $json.copy.metaDescription } } } }) }}

nodes.notes: Credential: HTTP Header Auth with name "X-Shopify-Access-Token". Never executed against a real store in this project.

nodes.name: Quarantine
nodes.notes: Fail closed: a product that fails any rule publishes nothing, and is reported with its violations.
